title: Managed-lane entitlement, meter-family, chargeback-scope, org-switch, and grace-period matrix
summary: Frozen entitlement, meter-family, chargeback-scope, org-switch, and grace-period matrix for the managed lanes. Every lane keeps a local-safe baseline, and a managed lane's marketed claim narrows automatically under the active managed state.

lanes.title: Managed AI gateway
lanes.summary: Token spend on the managed AI broker is metered per organization; direct and bring-your-own-key AI routes continue when the managed lane narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Direct and bring-your-own-key AI routes keep running.
Local editing, search, and Git are unaffected.
blocked_managed_only_actions: New managed-broker inference once the monthly token budget is exhausted.

lanes.title: Managed settings sync
lanes.summary: Stored bytes on the managed settings-sync store are metered per workspace; local settings and files stay authoritative when the lane narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Local settings and files stay authoritative on device.
Editing continues offline; sync resumes when the lane clears.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Pushing new settings snapshots to the managed store once storage is exhausted.

lanes.title: Companion relay
lanes.summary: Participant minutes on the managed relay are metered per workspace; local incident notes and offline packets continue when the relay narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Local incident notes and offline packets continue.
Desktop handoff resumes the exact local context.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Joining a live companion-follow or relay session once relay minutes are exhausted.

lanes.title: Registry and mirror
lanes.summary: Download count on the managed registry and mirror is metered per organization; installed extensions and local or sideloaded packages keep running when the lane narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Local and sideloaded packages are unaffected.
blocked_managed_only_actions: New managed-registry installs or publishes once the monthly download budget is exhausted.

lanes.title: Support ingest
lanes.summary: Support-bundle uploads to the managed ingest sink are metered per tenant; local support bundles still generate when the lane narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Local support bundles still generate on device.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Uploading new support bundles to the managed sink once the ingest budget is exhausted.

lanes.title: Managed workspace
lanes.summary: Remote workspace hours on the managed control plane are metered per organization; local checkout, editing, tasks, and Git continue when the remote workspace narrows.
local_safe_baseline: Local tasks and Git are unaffected when the remote workspace narrows.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Attaching or running a new remote workspace once the workspace-hour budget is exhausted.

managed_states.title: Signed in
managed_states.summary: A managed account is signed in and entitled; managed actions are admissible within seat, plan, policy, org, and provider posture.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Render the signed-in account scope; never imply the whole product depends on it.
managed_states.recovery_cue: No action needed; managed actions are admissible.

managed_states.title: Local only
managed_states.summary: The install has no managed account; the local core is fully usable and managed actions do not apply.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Render the local-only posture; never show a managed quota or spend number.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Sign in to a managed account to enable managed actions; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Reauth required
managed_states.summary: A managed reauthentication is required (signer rotation or attestation pending); managed actions pause until reauth completes.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Name reauth as the reason; never collapse it into a generic account error or a managed block.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Reauthenticate to resume managed actions; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Managed blocked
managed_states.summary: Managed actions are blocked by admin, policy, or provider posture; the local core remains usable.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Cite the policy or provider origin; never imply local work is blocked.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Review the account or policy hold to restore managed actions; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Grace period
managed_states.summary: A typed grace window is open; managed actions are admissible per the window and bounded artifacts can be exported before suspension.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Render the grace-window close time and the export-before-suspend path; never show grace as a hard block.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Export bounded artifacts before the grace window closes; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Seat removed
managed_states.summary: The user's seat was removed, reclaimed, or deprovisioned; managed actions for this seat block while local work continues.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Cite the seat as the origin; never collapse a seat loss into an org or account error.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Ask an admin to restore the seat to resume managed actions; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Plan downgrade
managed_states.summary: The plan was downgraded; managed actions narrow to the plan floor for the remainder of the term.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Cite the plan as the origin and name the plan-floor narrowing; never show it as a full block.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Managed actions are on the plan floor; upgrade the plan to widen them. Local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Org switched
managed_states.summary: The account or org was switched or transferred; managed scope is rebinding and the prior org's continuation is local-only for the transferor.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Cite the org switch and what migrates versus what stays local; never collapse it into a seat or generic account error.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Managed scope is rebinding to the new org; local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Forecast threshold
managed_states.summary: A metered family is approaching or crossed its forecast threshold; managed actions stay admissible with a budget warning.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Render the forecast with its unit, as-of time, and scope owner; never show a forecast under an unauthoritative state.
managed_states.recovery_cue: Usage is approaching the budget; raise the budget or wait for the window reset. Local work continues now.

managed_states.title: Meter stale
managed_states.summary: The meter or rating data is stale; the managed number cannot be confirmed now and is labeled stale rather than shown as live.
managed_states.required_disclosure: Label the number stale with its last as-of time; never block local editing, search, or Git on a stale meter.
managed_states.recovery_cue: The metered number is stale and labeled; managed actions resume when the meter refreshes. Local work continues now.

consumer_bindings.summary: The account and seat usage surface renders each lane's effective claim, unit, as-of time, and scope owner without re-deriving them.
Diagnostics and service-health surfaces project the lane fail posture and the active managed state without inventing a stronger claim.
The Help/About truth surface names which managed lanes are claimed and their local-safe baseline.
Support and admin export packets carry the lane's export guarantee, grace-period rights, and the posture origin of any narrowing.
Claim and public-truth automation narrows a marketed managed claim to the lane's effective claim when the active managed state caps it.
